what: A four-point star (30px, flickering 1→.7x and −5→10° every 1s) follows the cursor, covering .2 of the remaining distance each frame, and while it moves, every 50ms (when it has moved more than 2px) a tail star spawns 0~25px behind the cursor — 20~30·30~40·40~50px in size (30·40·30%), rotated ±360°, with larger ones scattering more slowly and drifting slightly downward (.4px per frame). Over .8s it holds at .8 until 60%, disappears at 77%, and shrinks at 1−1.2t (it isn’t stopped at 0, so at the end it flips and grows again). At spawn it is already .8, at its own angle and in its own place. Max 10.

options.min-width: Not applied below this width (px), default 769 (original turns off at 768 and below)

use: <body data-fx="sparkle-trail-cursor"> Or <section data-fx="sparkle-trail-cursor"> — In a section, the star follows only inside that box
note: Runs on gsap.ticker if gsap exists, otherwise on requestAnimationFrame. The stars are fixed elements attached to body, so they are drawn outside the board too. Not applied on touch devices or reduced-motion settings

from.where: shared.js sparkle cursor (original MouseTracker — ease .2 · 50ms · 10 pieces · 800ms · size 20~50 · speed 2×(1−(size−15)/30))
